author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Big umbrella with a centre rib on a pole into the cart box, box floor running forward as the frame, two open r6 wheels and a front stem with a handle: reads as an ice-cream tricycle cart like the reference.
omissions: The reference's cup seat, rear fender and scalloped canopy edge are left out; there is no room at 8-unit spacing.
